snippet.title: The House of Tesla - Official Trailer - FGS Live From Los Angeles
snippet.description:
The official trailer for The House of Tesla, a brand-new puzzle adventure from the devs behind The House of Da Vinci, with new handcrafted puzzles, hauntingly beautiful locations and challenges for your brain’s gray (or blue) matter. The House of Tesla is coming to PC later this year - wishlist now on Steam if you're keen. 

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #thehouseoftesla #houseoftesla
